messages.subject: Cedarbridge Business Park - agreed heads of terms
messages.plaintextBody:
All,

Further to agreement between the parties, please find attached the agreed heads of terms for the sale of Cedarbridge Business Park to Thornbury Properties at £14,250,000. Eight-week exclusivity runs from today. Solicitors are Birchall Stone (Oliver) for the seller and Whitfield Carter (James) for the buyer.

Let's aim for exchange by 21 November and completion 12 December.

Greg Vine
Calderbank Vine
